title: Wingfall SMP
description: Welcome to Wingfall SMP! This is a Semi - Vanilla Minecraft SMP.
body:
# 🌍 Welcome to Wingfall SMP > *A clean, welcoming, and fair Minecraft survival server.* Wingfall SMP focuses on providing the classic survival experience exactly as it was meant to be played. We stay away from the clutter of massive server networks to bring you a true community environment where your achievements actually matter. *** ### ✨ Core Philosophy We keep things simple and true to the base game. * **Strictly Vanilla:** You will not find overly complicated plugins, modified combat, or altered vanilla mechanics here. Just pure survival multiplayer. * **Zero Pay to Win:** We strongly believe in a completely fair playing field. There are absolutely no pay to win mechanics, premium ranks with unfair advantages, or special kits. * **Clean Survival Experience:** This is a place where you can relax, build massive projects, explore the world, and interact with a great community.
🛠️ Quality of Life Features (Click to Expand)
While we maintain a strict vanilla feel, we have added a few specific features to respect your time and make your gameplay smoother: * **Travel Commands:** Players have full access to `/tpa` to easily meet up with friends, and `/home` to safely mark base locations. * **Infinite Villager Restocks:** Trading and gathering resources is much less tedious! Our villagers restock infinitely, allowing you to get the materials and enchantments you need without having to wait around.
